## About
DR Roofing and Construction is a roofing and remodeling team based on Louisiana Ave in League City, with a North office on Tomball Pkwy in Vintage Park, Houston. We work on homes all over Greater Houston, from Clear Lake and Friendswood to Spring, Cypress and The Woodlands.
We know picking a contractor can feel stressful. Our goal is to make your roofing or remodeling project as hassle-free as we can, with honest answers and clear steps from the first visit to the final cleanup.
Beyond roofs, we handle gutters, siding, decks, patios and fences. We can also help with your insurance claim, and our finance department works with all credit situations.

## Services
- Roof replacement: Out with the old roof and in with a new one. One reviewer who compared quotes found the team competitively priced and professional.
- Emergency roof tarp: Storm, wind or hail damage, or a leak that can't wait. We tarp to protect your home until the roof is repaired or replaced.
- Board up: We secure windows and doors damaged by storm debris, wind, hail or vandalism, and board up ahead of hurricanes and tropical storms.
- Home improvement: Gutters, siding, decks, patios and fences, handled by the same team that does your roof.

## FAQ
Q: Do you give free estimates?
A: Yes. We offer free estimates in the Houston area. Call the South office in League City or the North office in Houston to set one up.

Q: What areas do you serve?
A: All of Greater Houston and the surrounding areas, including League City, Clear Lake, Webster, Friendswood, Pearland, Texas City, Pasadena, Deer Park, Baytown, Sugar Land, Cypress, Tomball, Spring and The Woodlands.

Q: Can you help me get ready for a hurricane?
A: Yes. We do board up services to help prevent damage from hurricanes and tropical storms.
